card.name: Warnings about avoiding or harmful drugs
card.fires_on: Words in cautionary statements where a drug is to be avoided or may worsen a condition, such as the middle of "corticosteroids" after "avoid", or "use" after "do not".

modes.label: Inside corticosteroid
modes.description: The middle of the word corticosteroid(s) in warnings about eye infections or herpes.
modes.example: Ocular Herpes Simplex Avoid cortic<<oster>>oids, including budesonide delayed

modes.label: Verb after a negation
modes.description: Verb or list comma following avoid, do not, or should not be in overdose or caution text.
modes.example: barbiturates should not be<< used>>. It should be borne in mind that

modes.label: Risk of delay or harm
modes.description: Word in a sentence saying a delay or poor handling leads to a bad outcome.
modes.example: after the onset of hypersensitivity<< may>> result in a life-threatening reaction.

card.writes: Pushes toward words about worsening or bad outcomes, such as exacerbate and 反而 (on the contrary).
card.plain: It lights up in warnings that say to avoid a drug or that something may make things worse.
